RdistNN: DNN Estimation for Conditional Effects and Regression

Source: R/RdistNN-package.R
RdistNN-package.Rd

Supported workflows include conditional average treatment effects with cate_dnn(), nonparametric regression with np_dnn(), conditional LATE with clate_dnn() and ordinary supplied-signal ratios with affine_ratio_dnn(), using distributional nearest-neighbor (DNN) weights and delete-1 jackknife standard errors. Nuisance predictions for causal estimators are supplied externally; the documented inference conditions remain estimator-specific. The underlying toolkit combines:

  • distance specifications (dnn_distance) for ranking observations around a target;

  • rank-weight specifications (rank_weight) for converting ranks to weights;

  • score objects (ustat_score) for flexible kernel-based moment evaluation.

Main User Workflows

  • Compute DNN weights with weights_dnn(), weights_dnn_exact(), and weights_dnn_asymp().

  • Resolve paper-default kernel orders with tuning_dnn_paper() and tuning_eval().

  • Estimate local CATE targets with cate_dnn().

  • Report and reuse CATE fits with summary.cate_result(), confint.cate_result(), vcov.cate_result() and predict.cate_result().

  • Estimate local nonparametric means with np_dnn().

  • Use two-scale signed-weight regression with np_tdnn(); see its help for order constraints and additional smoothness requirements. Both regression classes share reporting, joint covariance and prediction methods documented in np_result.

  • Estimate conditional LATE from supplied nuisance predictions with clate_dnn(), or localize two supplied signals with affine_ratio_dnn(). iv_augmented_signals() constructs the augmented binary-IV signals. Reporting methods and diagnostics() retain components and statuses. clate_demo_data() supplies a bounded synthetic benchmark with oracle predictions.

  • Inspect fitted local estimators with diagnostics().

  • Plot CATE and regression estimates with plot_estimates() and inspect local weights with plot_weights() (requires ggplot2).

Exact distance ties

Distance-based estimators average rank weights within exactly equal computed distances, separately for every target, including each deletion's surviving members. Block mass is preserved for signed and unnormalized rules. Equality uses represented values without a tolerance. Bare ranks/orders remain strict; adding dx metadata enables averaging while preserving supplied permutations. Calls with ties warn once: the accompanying theory assumes a continuous distance distribution and does not establish inference under persistent ties. Earlier retained fit schemas require refitting before reporting or reuse.

Experimental and Advanced Workflows

All PLQR functionality is experimental, including plqr_dnn(), its scores, demo helpers, methods, and plots. The current wrapper evaluates moments at a supplied coefficient; it does not solve for local coefficients. Local IV-GMM functionality is also experimental. These workflows are outside the supported workflow focus. The optional ratio_confidence_set() API remains experimental and provides separate set-valued moment inversion.

  • Build custom generalized U-statistics with new_score(), score_eval_batch(), and score_diff_path().

  • Estimate uncertainty with jackknife_fast_rank() and jackknife_slow_rank().

Random numbers

Explicit demo and simulation seeds restore .Random.seed and RNGkind(); NULL uses the current stream. R's saved state does not include the hidden Box-Muller normal cache; use the default normal generator for saved-state reproducibility.

Native threads

Compiled routines use at most two OpenMP threads by default. Set options(RdistNN.num_threads = 1L) for one native thread, or supply a larger positive integer to opt into more threads. Lower OpenMP runtime limits are respected; builds without OpenMP run serially. This option does not change other packages' thread settings.

Documentation Map

  • Start with vignette("getting-started", package = "RdistNN").

  • For step-by-step extension patterns for custom distances, rank weights, and scores, see vignette("extending", package = "RdistNN").

  • For modular kernel-order tuning rules and registry usage, see vignette("kernel-order-tuning", package = "RdistNN").

  • For fitted-object diagnostics and reporting, see vignette("diagnostics-reporting", package = "RdistNN").

  • For distance/rank weighting details see vignette("dnn-weights", package = "RdistNN").

  • For experimental PLQR moments and coefficient uncertainty, see vignette("conditional-z-estimation", package = "RdistNN").

  • For supplied-prediction conditional LATE and paired inference, see vignette("conditional-late", package = "RdistNN") and vignette("conditional-late-inference", package = "RdistNN").

  • For jackknife details see vignette("jackknife-gen-ustats", package = "RdistNN").

  • For statistical background, assumptions and theoretical results, see the accompanying paper.
